basis: All six pages inspected from independently saved waveforms, without a published reference image. Limited visual inspection; not expert-validated phase or hybrid labels.
selection: Four highest correlations and two highest CAAM SNRs among baseline 822 crossings; not a random sample.

findings.observation: Sustained oscillations before, during and after alignment; no convincing isolated onset in this displayed interval. Negative FI alone does not establish a hybrid.

Clear impulsive wave packet at both stations, with later larger horizontal motion. Positive FI and this shape are compatible with ordinary earthquake body waves; a hybrid identity or family is not established.
Large CAAM oscillatory pulses near alignment and +8 s lack a comparably visible COLB counterpart; no secure two-station hybrid confirmation.
Sustained oscillations without a distinct common onset; measured signal power is below preceding-window power.
Impulsive event visible at both stations, with positive FI. No family or hybrid classification follows from the threshold crossing.
Strong CAAM pulses without a clear COLB counterpart; low FI is insufficient for confirmation.

interpretation: Inspection supports retaining these as unconfirmed crossings. No catalog-wide false-positive rate, event classification or onset truth is inferred from six examples.
